newsitem.title: UK: Powergen up as Goldman repeats "outperform".
newsitem.headline: Powergen up as Goldman repeats "outperform".

text.p: Shares in Powergen Plc rose on Friday in further reaction to the power generator's share buyback programme and as Goldman Sachs repeated an "outperform" rating on the stock, dealers said.
The shares gained 9-1/2p to 563-1/2p by 1553 GMT. Shares in rival National Power Plc also rose, to be up 8-1/2p at 443-1/2p ahead of half-year results on Wednesday.
Philip Green, analyst at Goldman Sachs, increased his post- exceptional EPS forecast for fiscal 1997 from 61.6p to 63.4p and set a 621p price target on the stock.
PowerGen said last Thursday it planned to buy back up to 10 percent of its equity in coming weeks.
The company also reported strong half-year pretax profits of 138 million stg against 133 million stg for same period last year.
